reader.requirement: At --std 85 a sum counter's qualifiers are the data-names of the report group entries above it, with the report-name as the outermost permissible qualifier, wherever the sum counter is referenced (the procedure division, a SOURCE or SUM clause, and the 1985 data-division clause operand). A qualifier written beyond the report-name, such as the report file's file-name, or one that is not an ancestor, must be refused, and qualification by report-name must resolve a homonym.

edition-consulted.switches: at 85 only (DialectLevel >= 2002 returns null) a sum counter may be the operand of a data-division clause, such as an OCCURS DEPENDING ON object; it resolves through the same SumCountersNamed/QualifierWalk lookup

reader.edition-search: grep DialectLevel / Edition in CounterResolver.cs#SumCounterFamilyFor, ReportScope.cs#SumCountersNamed and DataBinder.QualifierWalk: none. The qualifier walk is one code path for every edition
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 a sum counter may also be named by a data-division clause (SumCounterOperand85), and that 85-only arm uses the same qualifier walk; the qualifier rule itself does not differ
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses cover general qualification and a report group qualified by report-name, not a sum counter qualified beyond its report-name or a homonym across two reports

reader.notes: One qualifier walk (DataBinder.QualifierWalk, with the report-name accepted only as the last qualifier) serves the procedure division, the SOURCE and SUM clauses and the 85-only data-division operand. Every qualifier beyond the report-name is refused, and report-name qualification resolves the cross-report homonym. The SUM-clause refusal (COBOL2730) words the error as 'names no entry', which is accurate if less specific.

refuter.evidence: Read DataBinder.QualifierWalk and ReportScope.SumCountersNamed path as the reader named; no edition test on the walk. Probes at --std 85 built from the reader q-ok.cob (two reports each with sum counter TOT): r-qorder.cob MOVE TOT OF RPT OF CF1 (report-name not outermost) -> COBOL2145 (r-qorder-001); r-qws.cob MOVE TOT OF WS-OUT (a storage item as qualifier) -> COBOL2145 (r-qws-001); r-qcross.cob MOVE TOT OF CF1 OF RPT2 (group of RPT under report-name RPT2) -> COBOL2145 (r-qcross-001).
